report.interpretation: This is a follow-up to the June 2025 question. It uses the same measure: the agreed paid_amount metric, which sums claim_payments.amount by payment date. The period is 1 to 31 August 2026, split by payee type, across all products and states.
report.answer: We paid out about $10.23M in August 2026. By payee type: policyholders $5,289,214 (297 payments), repair shops $2,596,341 (453 payments), contractors $1,917,660 (104 payments) and claimants $430,002 (48 payments). All rows came from nightly batches, with no duplicate reload rows. Payments are complete through 31 August. This is roughly three times June 2025 ($3.46M). The mix has also shifted: policyholder and contractor payments are much larger, and claimant payments are smaller. I haven't investigated why. I can run a why analysis if you want one.
report.answer_sql: SELECT payee_type, round(sum(amount),2) AS paid_amount FROM claim_payments WHERE payment_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND payment_date < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY payee_type ORDER BY paid_amount DESC
